reproducible: cross-checkout: the catalog and the history pin every session cwd to <corpus>/project and record the canonical digests with that token, so two generations in different directories (vendor/performance-fixture and /tmp/corpus-alt) produced identical generator, catalog canonical and history canonical digests; ids and timestamps are assigned deterministically and createdAt is the only varying field

superseded.reason: pre-canonical corpus whose digests embedded the authoring checkout path

canonicalization.note: Canonical fields replace the corpus project path (every Session's cwd) with <corpus>/project and are the reproducible identity. Raw bytes/sha256 are the payload as written in this checkout, because the gate grants the corpus project directory and the product lists only granted directories.
